flutter analyze (Flutter 3.47.2) on `Text('x', style: const TextStyle(color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error))`: "error - Methods can't be invoked in constant expressions - const_eval_method_invocation". The analyzer rejects it statically, i.e. a const value must be computable at compile time; Theme.of runs at run time. The C# parallel (const = compile-time constant) is a framing, not a Flutter claim.
